verdict.rationale: Pipedream's REST API and CLI let users manage workflows and pull code locally (pipedream-docs-6, pipedream-docs-7, pipedream-docs-8), and a community comment notes workflow logic is just portable Node.js code that could be extracted if leaving (pipedream-comm-1). However there is no explicit documented 'export all my data' feature (e.g., bulk data/backup export in open formats) and a user explicitly wishes the workflow engine itself were open source, implying the platform isn't fully open/portable (pipedream-comm-9). missing for 10: explicit bulk data export tooling, documented open-format export of workflow/event data, confirmation that all stored data (not just code) can be extracted.
